correctness.rationale: The forcing argument reconstructs every required step: a dense separation lemma; movement in each infinite ground-model block; decision of moved points and images; Delta-system thinning; elimination of root-image collisions by injectivity; and an n-way free amalgam assigning opposite relation values to source and image cross-petal n-sets. These steps contradict relation preservation by any forced nonidentity automorphism. The proof uses distinct points, so conventions about repeated-coordinate relation tuples do not affect it. The finite checker is explicitly only a bookkeeping sanity check.
